colophon.subtitle.zh: 这座博物馆是如何 build 的

colophon.idea.body.en: Everything I build is a small world: a music box with an opera house inside, a tin for little things, a garden that keeps its own calendar, a scroll you walk through with a lantern. So I laid this site out as a museum. The works stand on an arc under one light, numbered like lots in an auction catalogue, and each gets a wall label that says what it is made of. One room holds things that are fun to play with; the other holds things that might make you think.
colophon.idea.body.zh: 我 build 的东西，都是一个小世界。一只装着歌剧院的音乐盒，一个收小东西的铁盒，一座有自己花历的花园，一幅要提着灯走进去的画卷。所以我把这个网站布置成了一座陈列馆，作品在一束光下沿着弧线排开，像拍卖图录一样编号，每件配一张展签，写着它是由什么做成的。一间展厅放一些好玩的东西，另一间放或许会让你思考的东西。

colophon.type.intro.en: Six typefaces, all under open licenses.

colophon.type.cormorant.en: Display. Headlines and the gallery title.
colophon.type.cormorant.zh: 标题。首页大标题和各个展厅的标题。

colophon.type.dmsans.en: Text. Everything you read at length.
colophon.type.dmsans.zh: 正文。所有需要慢慢读的文字。

colophon.type.compagnon.en: Museum labels. Lot numbers, dates and small captions.
colophon.type.compagnon.zh: 展签。编号、日期和小字说明。

colophon.type.xiangcui.en: Chinese display. It loads in Chinese mode, and holds only the characters this site uses.
colophon.type.xiangcui.zh: 中文标题。在中文模式下加载，只包含本站用到的字。

colophon.details.lantern.en: In the gallery, your pointer is a lantern: the light follows it.
colophon.details.lantern.zh: 展厅里，你的鼠标就是一盏灯，光会跟着它走。

colophon.details.shadow.en: Each work casts its shadow away from your lantern.
colophon.details.shadow.zh: 每件展品的影子都会避开你的提灯，落向另一边。

colophon.details.color.en: Colors fade the farther a work stands from the light, the way they do for our eyes in a dim room.
colophon.details.color.zh: 离灯光越远，颜色就会越淡，就像人眼在暗处看东西。

colophon.details.spot.en: Stop in front of a work and the light settles on it.
colophon.details.spot.zh: 在一件展品前停下，光会落到它身上。

colophon.details.counter.en: The lot counter rolls like a mechanical one.
colophon.details.counter.zh: 右上角的展品编号像机械计数器一样滚动。

colophon.details.marginalia.en: In Things that think, each number gets a pencil line once it has counted up, like a note in the margin.
colophon.details.marginalia.zh: 在 Things that think 这一室，数字数完之后会被铅笔划上一道，像读书时写的批注。

colophon.details.cover.en: Open a work and its cover carries you into its page, in browsers that support it.
colophon.details.cover.zh: 点开一件作品，封面会一路把你送进它的页面（需要浏览器支持）。

colophon.details.lots.en: Lots are numbered newest first, in the order I made them.
colophon.details.lots.zh: 展品按我做它们的时间编号，最新的在最前面。

colophon.details.lights.en: Between the gallery and the reading rooms, the lights come up.
colophon.details.lights.zh: 从展厅走进阅读室的时候，灯会慢慢亮起来。

colophon.details.moon.en: The loader is a small moon walking through its phases in steps, a nod to the hand-made jitter in 1001 States of the Moon.
colophon.details.moon.zh: 加载提示是一枚一格一格走过月相的小月亮，致敬《月亮的一千零一种状态》里的手作抖动。

colophon.details.walk.en: The footer keeps count of how far you have scrolled today, at 1,000 pixels to the meter.
colophon.details.walk.zh: 页脚会记下你今天滚动了多远，1,000 像素算 1 米。

colophon.details.irisy.en: If you would rather ask than read, Irisy, my digital twin, waits in the corner.
colophon.details.irisy.zh: 不想读那么多文字的话，右下角的 Irisy 是我的数字分身，可以直接问她。

colophon.built.body.en: Hand-written HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with no framework. Words live in Markdown and JSON, and a few small Node scripts turn them into pages. The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. I build it with Claude Code and Codex as collaborators.
colophon.built.body.zh: 手写的 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript，没有用框架。文字放在 Markdown 和 JSON 里，几个小小的 Node 脚本把它们变成页面。网站托管在 GitHub Pages 上。我和 Claude Code、Codex 一起搭建出来。

colophon.credits.body.en: The covers are screenshots of my own works. All fonts are used under the SIL Open Font License; the license ships with the site.
colophon.credits.body.zh: 封面都是我自己作品的截图。所有字体都按 SIL 开源字体许可使用，许可文件随网站一起发布。
